segments.t: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
segments.note: φρονεῖτε を「Set your mind on」とほぐす

segments.t: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν（あなたがたの命）だが WEB は「our life」と訳す（異本 ἡμῶν 系）

segments.t: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
segments.note: Νεκρώσατε を「Put to death」とほぐす。「your」は英語の補い

segments.t: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（ἐν οἷς καὶ ὑμεῖς περιεπατήσατέ ποτε）

segments.t: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
segments.note: τοῦ κτίσαντος αὐτόν を「his Creator」とほぐす

segments.t: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
segments.note: οὐκ ἔνι を「there can’t be」とほぐす

segments.t: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
segments.note: σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ を「a heart of compassion」とほぐす。ταπεινοφροσύνην は「lowliness, humility」

segments.t: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は ὁ κύριος（主）だが WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Christ」とする

segments.t: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
segments.note: 動詞は12節の Ἐνδύσασθε から続き、WEB は「walk in」と補う

segments.t: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ Χριστοῦ だが WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「the peace of God」とする

segments.t: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は τῷ θεῷ（神に）だが WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「to the Lord」とする

segments.t: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
segments.note: εὐάρεστόν ἐστιν ἐν κυρίῳ を「this pleases the Lord」とほぐす

segments.t: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
segments.note: ὀφθαλμοδουλίαις を「not just when they are looking」とほぐす。ギリシャ語本文は τὸν κύριον（主）だが WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「God」とする

segments.t: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
segments.note: ἐκ ψυχῆς ἐργάζεσθε を「work heartily」とほぐす。文頭は καὶ πᾶν ὃ ἐὰν ποιῆτε のほぐし

segments.t: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
segments.note: 「for」は英語の補い（τῷ κυρίῳ Χριστῷ δουλεύετε は直説法）

segments.t: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
segments.note: κομίσεται ὃ ἠδίκησεν を「will receive again for the wrong that he has done」とほぐす
